purpose: Exploratory full-scanner comparisons; these are not the five 78-scan pairs required for goal completion.
contract_checks: Every probe preserved both size-mode mappings, descending output order, successful exit, and absence of incomplete-total warnings on the unchanged default fixture. All source variants passed the accounting tests.
metadata_probe: On x86-64, request masks limited to TYPE, SIZE, and BLOCKS use raw SYS_newfstatat with AT_SYMLINK_NOFOLLOW | 0x4000 (DONT_SYNC); libc::stat is adapted to the existing size inspector. Other requests retain statx.
directory_order_probe: Add the getdents64 inode number to each retained child record (24 bytes instead of 16) and sort child records by inode before recursion. No hardlink deduplication.
file_order_probe: Additionally sort known non-directory records by inode per enumeration batch. Narrow directories keep up to 64 borrowed-name records on the stack and stat serially; wide batches retain Rayon metadata jobs.

interpretation.fstatat-trial: Rejected: task-clock and elapsed essentially unchanged, with about 5% more user instructions.
interpretation.fstatat-inline-trial: Rejected as an interface replacement: inlining lowered instructions about 7% versus the streaming reference in one pair, but neither elapsed nor task-clock improved. Native result adaptation was already eliminated for some monomorphizations; the results do not establish adapter copying as the cause.
interpretation.statx-inline-trial: About 2% fewer instructions with the original statx interface. Apparent elapsed and task-clock essentially unchanged; allocated reference second batch had higher task-clock, so its apparent timing gain needs confirmation.
interpretation.inode-order-trial: Rejected: about 1% less task-clock, no elapsed improvement, and about 6% more instructions.
interpretation.inode-file-order-trial: Rejected: about 1% less task-clock but roughly 30% more instructions and worse elapsed in the single exploratory pair.
